blockingFindings.description: Direct V107 review and side-by-side comparison with V106 show no clear visible reduction in broad faceted patches on the jacket torso, side/underarm, waist and hip surfaces. The declared panel-local smooth shading and canonical seam split are present in the build audit, but appearance remains visibly faceted. The measured within-panel face-normal discontinuity p95 is 32.09 degrees on jacket back panels and 61.98–69.09 degrees on front torso panels; investigate face winding/orientation and surface geometry before another shading-only change.
The garment still reads almost entirely as plain white cloth with a narrow lavender chest sash and sparse piping; lamé surface character and fencing-practice identity are not legible.

Crouch, sit and prone retain severe skirt/underlayer bunching, flare or inversion. Avatar fit, final weights, shape-key response, validated UVs, Unity/VRChat runtime and package eligibility remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
